assessments.summary: The verifier’s audited logic is substantially sound, and the final rigidity implication follows conditionally from the asserted exhaustive census. However, the supplied evidence contains no successful governed-run or terminal attestation showing that the configuration has the claimed digest and no-three-in-line property or that the verifier actually established the symmetry, embedding, blocking, and deletion statistics. Static code correctness and reported aggregates do not establish those computational facts.
scopeQualifications: The conditional conclusion applies only to the eight asserted embeddings in G_77.
It does not establish rigidity for arbitrary record configurations or determine the global value of D(77).

If the exhaustive clauses hold, then for every no-three-in-line S with |E minus S| at most 2, one has |S minus E| at most 1 and |S| at most 152; consequently |S| at least 153 forces |E minus S| at least 3, |S minus E| at least 4, and symmetric difference at least 7.
evidenceIssues: No terminal governed-run attestation or other affirmative execution record is supplied.
The claimed SHA-256 digest, decoding, and exhaustive no-three-in-line check are not independently demonstrated in the bounded evidence.
Quarter-turn invariance, exactly two dihedral images, and exactly eight translated embeddings remain computationally unverified.

The universal minimum-two-blockers assertion, absence of singleton freeings, at-most-one-cell deletion-pair property, and exactly 16 exceptional deletion pairs per embedding lack an independently checkable proof trace.
results.json supplies aggregates and positive cases but not sufficient witnesses for the universal and negative assertions; verification.json is only a request.
The byte-for-byte comparison between recomputed output and results.json has not been shown to have succeeded.
